tooling.message:
docs(arc42): count the creator's turns after the confirmed plan, not decisions

## Intent

Counting the creator's decisions is a poor measure: many turns before the plan can mean good assistance. Once the creator confirms the plan, the assistant should work on its own.

## Key changes

- qs-few-turns-after-plan replaces qs-few-decisions: at most 3 creator turns from the confirmed plan to the listing pull request.
- The retrospective section of the plan records those turns and is the source of the number.
